metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for game development: 20 game dev plugins (Godot, Unity, Unreal, rendering, AI, netcode, shipping) plus optional hooks, alongside 66 general development plugins derived from wshobson/agents.

plugins.name: godot-development
plugins.description: Godot 4 development: Node tree and scene design, signals, resources, physics, animation, typed GDScript or C#, GDExtension, and GUT tests.

plugins.name: unity-development
plugins.description: Unity 6 development: MonoBehaviour or DOTS architecture, URP and HDRP, Addressables, the Input System, ScriptableObjects, and idiomatic C#.

plugins.name: unreal-engine
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5 development: Gameplay Framework, Blueprint or C++, the Gameplay Ability System, Enhanced Input, replication, and Lumen and Nanite.

plugins.name: game-architecture
plugins.description: Game code architecture: game loops, ECS, event buses, data resources, service locators, scene management, and state stacks.

plugins.name: input-systems
plugins.description: Game input systems: action maps, gamepad deadzones, input buffering, rebinding, touch controls, and rumble across Godot, Unity, and Unreal.

plugins.name: save-systems
plugins.description: Game save systems: serialization, save file versioning and migration, atomic writes, slots, settings persistence, and platform cloud saves.

plugins.name: localization
plugins.description: Game localization: string extraction, gettext PO files, ICU plurals, right-to-left layout, CJK font fallback, and pseudo-localization.

plugins.name: shader-programming
plugins.description: Real-time shaders for games: Godot shading language, vertex and fragment stages, common effects, post-processing, and shader performance.

plugins.name: animation-systems
plugins.description: Game animation systems: blend trees, state machines, IK, root motion, and animation events across Godot AnimationTree, Unity Animator, and Unreal AnimGraph.

plugins.name: audio-systems
plugins.description: Game audio implementation: bus architecture, spatial audio, dynamic music, sound pooling, and FMOD or Wwise integration.

plugins.name: ui-game-design
plugins.description: Game UI: HUDs, menu stacks, inventory grids, dialogue boxes, settings screens, and accessibility with Godot Control nodes.

plugins.name: ai-game-behavior
plugins.description: NPC and enemy AI for games: behavior trees, state machines, utility AI, GOAP, navmesh pathfinding, and perception systems.

plugins.name: physics-simulation
plugins.description: Game physics: body types, collision layers, character controllers, raycasts, triggers, joints, and physics performance in Godot and Unity.

plugins.name: procedural-generation
plugins.description: Procedural generation: noise terrain, BSP and cellular automata dungeons, Wave Function Collapse, seeded randomness, and solvability checks.

plugins.name: level-design
plugins.description: Level design and construction: greyboxing, TileMaps, modular kits, navmesh baking, level streaming, and environmental storytelling.

plugins.name: playtesting
plugins.description: Playtesting and game analytics: session design, observation protocols, telemetry schemas, death heatmaps, funnels, and A/B tests.

plugins.name: performance-optimization
plugins.description: Game performance: profiling methodology, draw call batching, LODs, occlusion culling, object pooling, and GDScript hot path fixes.

plugins.name: asset-pipelines
plugins.description: Game asset pipelines: import settings, texture atlasing, LOD generation, audio compression, and CI asset validation for Godot and Unity.

plugins.name: multiplayer-networking
plugins.description: Multiplayer netcode: rollback, lockstep, client prediction with reconciliation, lag compensation, bandwidth budgets, NAT traversal, and Godot or Unity networking.

plugins.name: monetization-ethics
plugins.description: Ethical game monetization: dark pattern audits, cosmetics-only stores, fair battle passes, platform IAP flows, and player spending protection.

plugins.name: libre-gamedev-hooks
plugins.description: Optional game dev hooks: a one-line note when the project is Godot, Unity, Unreal, or a web game, confirmation before touching secrets or signing keys or running destructive commands, and a check after writes.
